Distance Learning Courses
Spray equipment courses are available through the Cornell IPM Pesticide Safety Education Program at pmepcourses.cce.cornell.edu:
Nozzle Selection and Calibration for Vineyard Canopy Sprayers
Nozzle Selection and Calibration for Orchard Canopy Sprayers
Effective Spraying with Backpack Sprayers
Effective Spraying with Boom Sprayers

Note: A small administrative fee is charged to take these courses and DEC credits are awarded once successfully completed. Courses are also approved for recertification credits in Maryland, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, and all New England states.
